note: Clear app header, navigation rail, outline, cell cards and primary Run all action.
Readable code and comfortable card spacing; secondary labels are small.
Light and dark themes share a coherent component vocabulary.
Notebook is balanced; repeated operation records and JSON clutter supporting screens.
Six clearly labeled destinations and visible active selection.
Filtering and no-match feedback work; filtering affects only the outline and selection can remain offscreen.
Sessions to executions to detail works, but no visible breadcrumb or dedicated back action.
Settings retains doctor JSON and a prior panel's scroll position; source confirms one shared inspection value.

criterion: Initial value proposition and first action
note: Clear welcome text, Open notebook CTA and statement that opening starts no worker.
Startup only offers opening a directory; creating a notebook requires CLI knowledge.
No visible recent notebook list, guided example or sample notebook action.
Shortcut list is helpful, but run shortcut behavior depends on focus in ways the list does not explain.
Python syntax highlighting, line numbers and labeled cell editors are present.
An edit was saved to cells/sales.py; stale output badge and outline marker appeared.
Adding succeeds but keeps the old viewport and selection rather than placing the new editor in view.
Add/delete work; delete is immediate and Ctrl+Z did not restore the cell. Structural undo is documented as unfinished.
Mouse run and Run all executed code and retained output; batch error was visible.
A 30-second sleep showed Running, then Interrupted and Idle after Interrupt.
Open was offline and first execution started a worker. Final Stop shut down the runtime but left a Disconnected chip and OS error 10053; reopening is needed for a clean offline state.
Global execution controls remain on inspection/settings screens; idle interrupt and destructive controls have little state-specific guidance.
Runtime chip, cell status and execution ordinal make completion and running state visible.
Stale output, outline markers and No cells match provide useful feedback.
Operations show UUID/state without task names or timestamps; after Stop, a running operation label remained despite runtime shutdown.
History session says running while the worker chip says Idle; this distinction is not explained.
Text/result separation and a prominent traceback preserve useful detail.
A four-row pandas table and matplotlib PNG rendered correctly in the native UI.
Markdown renders with emphasis and headings, but source and preview occupy space simultaneously.
MIME chooser/export, output search, full attachment preview and bounded large-output paging remain unfinished; not all MIME types were exercised.
Execution rows primarily contain UUIDs; cell names, time and duration are missing from the list.
Data is available as raw JSON; source comparison and a formatted execution detail view are missing.

criterion: Find, filter and sort recorded work
note: No visible history search or time/status filtering; the left search is cell filtering.
Runtime rows show IDs and verified badges rather than useful path/interpreter/activity summaries.
A complete checkpoint was created and restored; ledger records a new session linked to it.
Doctor/reconnect tools exist but use raw JSON. Reconnect/reload was clicked after Stop; the Disconnected chip and error remained in the follow-up capture, although later history inspection worked.
Trust/mismatch options and warning exist; no concise summary of restored bindings or typed recovery guidance.
Draft/conflict/recovery features are documented but crashes, simultaneous edits and draft replay were not induced. Stop-related disconnect behavior is rated in the lifecycle/diagnostics criteria.

One click removes the source cell from the notebook immediately; no confirmation, Undo action or working structural Ctrl+Z observed. This does not claim execution history or all possible CLI recovery paths are erased.
Restore and Stop ask for confirmation; Escape dismisses and trust/mismatch are explicit.
Stop reuses a warning about executing saved code, target is {}, and the action label is generic Proceed.
Trust options and closing-detaches message are visible. This is a UX assessment, not a security audit.
Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Enter inserted newlines in editor focus; Escape followed by Shift+Enter executed the selected cell.
Filtering checkpoint worked, but Arrow Down + Enter did not select or execute it; implementation has click handlers only.
Escape dismisses confirmations and returns to command mode; status bar distinguishes edit/command mode.

criterion: Complete tab journey and modal focus containment
note: Focusable controls exist, but a full Tab/Shift+Tab journey, focus restoration and modal trap were not tested.
UI Automation exposes 29 descendants including named buttons/inputs/editors. Navigation destinations and rendered outputs were absent from this snapshot.
Native window has an empty title/name and repeated Run/Delete labels lack a cell name in the exposed tree.

criterion: Measured text, nontext and focus contrast
note: Visual inspection alone cannot certify contrast. No pixel/token contrast calculation was performed.

criterion: Screen reader, high contrast, IME and text scaling
note: NVDA, system high contrast, IME, mixed DPI and enlarged text remain qualification work; no conformance claim.
Notebook is usable at about 1280 logical pixels, but checkpoint row actions already clip on the right.
At 800 logical pixels, runtime state and cell-add actions are clipped; no adaptive toolbar overflow was visible.
Confirmation description paints past the right edge; checkpoint actions clip at 1024 and 800.

criterion: Mixed DPI, secondary monitor and extreme sizing
note: Observed on one Windows display at 200% scaling; other DPI configurations and monitors were not tested.
Observed interactions completed and app stayed responsive while code ran; no app crash during completed workflows.
No repeatable timing harness was run. Screenshot-tool time is not an application latency measurement.
Six-cell fixture only; no large history, 100 MiB output, image-cache or long-session stress test.
Memory, frame times, GPU fallback and long-running resource behavior were not measured.
Header and Settings theme switches work.
Choose project interpreter exists, but current selected path/version is not summarized in Settings; picker was not exercised.
Dark theme returned to light on relaunch; source initializes apply_theme(false) and dark:false.
System/high-contrast preference, key rebinding and full config fields remain unfinished.
Startup shortcuts and tooltips help, but no visible in-app help, glossary or documentation entry point.
Ordinary notebook labels are clear; namespace, runtime, interpreter and Continue/Restore need explanation.

criterion: Native shell identity and release information
note: Window title is empty and version/About is not visible. Installer, signing and update UX were not tested.
Coverage is honestly documented in the repo, but UI offers little guidance about unimplemented exchange/publish workflows.
